title: A day in the life of a baker
transcript:
Hi! I'm Sam Rivera and I'm a baker. My day starts very early! I get up at half past three. Yes, three thirty in the morning!

I never have breakfast at home. I take a shower, get dressed and walk to the bakery. I start work at four o'clock. First, I make the bread. The bakery opens at seven, and people always want coffee and warm bread.

My sister Rosa works with me. She serves the customers, and I usually stay in the kitchen. I have lunch at eleven thirty. That's early, I know! I finish work at one o'clock.

In the afternoon, I sometimes play soccer with my friends, or I sleep for an hour. I have dinner with my wife at six, and we often watch a movie. I go to bed at nine o'clock. Always at nine!
